50548-a-beginner-s-history.title: A Beginner S History
50548-a-beginner-s-history.creator: Unknown
50548-a-beginner-s-history.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The teacher should use the stories in this book to impress upon the pupil's mind the idea that life is a constant struggle against opposing difficulties. The pupil should be able to see that the great men of American history spent their lives in a ceaseless effort to conquer obstacles. For everywhere men find opponents.

arxiv-2009-11155.title: Dark Photon Search at Yemilab, Korea
arxiv-2009-11155.creator: S. H. Seo, Y. D. Kim
arxiv-2009-11155.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by S. H. Seo, Y. D. Kim. Dark photons are well motivated hypothetical dark sector particles that could account for observations that cannot be explained by the standard model of particle physics. A search for dark photons that are produced by an electron beam striking a thick tungsten target and subsequently interact in a 3 kiloton-scale neutrino detector in Yemilab, a new underground lab in Korea, is proposed.

arxiv-2108-02641.title: Complexity analysis of quantum teleportation via different entangled channels in the presence of noise
arxiv-2108-02641.creator: Deepak Singh ID, Sanjeev Kumar ID, Bikash K. Behera ID
arxiv-2108-02641.description: Abstract Quantum communication is one of the hot topics in quantum computing, where teleportation of a quantum state has a slight edge and gained significant attention from researchers. A large number of teleportation schemes have already been introduced so far.

arxiv-2310-02860.title: A study of some recent irreducibility criteria for polynomials having integer coefficients
arxiv-2310-02860.creator: Sanjeev Kumar †, Jitender Singh ‡,∗
arxiv-2310-02860.description: Abstract . In this article, we give an account of some recent irreducibility testing criteria for polynomials having integer coefficients over the field of rational numbers. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 12E05; 11C08 3 3 footnotetext: ,∗ Corresponding author: jitender.math@gndu.ac.in 2 2 footnotetext: sanjeev_kumar_19@yahoo.co.in 1.

arxiv-2311-13939.title: 5G Edge Vision: Wearable Assistive Technology for People with Blindness and Low Vision
arxiv-2311-13939.creator: Tommy Azzino ∗ , Marco Mezzavilla ∗ , Sundeep Rangan ∗ , Yao Wang ∗ , John-Ross Rizzo ∗ ⁣ † {}^{*\ \dagger}
arxiv-2311-13939.description: Abstract In an increasingly visual world, people with blindness and low vision (pBLV) face substantial challenges in navigating their surroundings and interpreting visual information. From our previous work, VIS 4 ION is a smart wearable that helps pBLV in their day-to-day challenges.

arxiv-2403-18060.title: The Cordiality Game and the Game Cordiality Number
arxiv-2403-18060.creator: Elliot Krop, Aryan Mittal, Michael C. Wigal
arxiv-2403-18060.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Elliot Krop, Aryan Mittal, Michael C. Wigal. The cordiality game is played on a graph G G by two players, Admirable (A) and Impish (I), who take turns selecting unlabeled vertices of G G . Admirable labels the selected vertices by 0 0 and Impish by 1 1 , and the resulting label on any edge is the sum modulo 2 2 of the labels of the vertices incident to that edge.

arxiv-2409-16132.title: Large Bayesian Tensor VARs with Stochastic Volatility
arxiv-2409-16132.creator: Joshua C. C. Chan, Yaling Qi
arxiv-2409-16132.description: Abstract We consider Bayesian tensor vector autoregressions (TVARs) in which the VAR coefficients are arranged as a three-dimensional array or tensor, and this coefficient tensor is parameterized using a low-rank CP decomposition. We develop a family of TVARs using a general stochastic volatility specification, which includes a wide variety of commonly-used multivariate stochastic volatility and COVID-19 outlier-augmented models.

arxiv-2503-13954.title: Enhanced High-Dimensional Data Visualization through Adaptive Multi-Scale Manifold Embedding
arxiv-2503-13954.creator: Tianhao Ni *, Bingjie Li *, Zhigang Yao
arxiv-2503-13954.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Tianhao Ni *, Bingjie Li *, Zhigang Yao. To address the dual challenges of the curse of dimensionality and the difficulty in separating intra-cluster and inter-cluster structures in high-dimensional manifold embedding, we proposes an Adaptive Multi-Scale Manifold Embedding (AMSME) algorithm. By introducing ordinal distance to replace traditional Euclidean distances, we theoretically demonstrate that ordinal distance overcomes the constraints of the curse of dimensionality in high-dimensional spaces, effectively distinguishing heterogeneous samples.

arxiv-2509-19428.title: X-rays from Inelastic Dark Matter Freeze-in
arxiv-2509-19428.creator: Gordan Krnjaic, David McKeen, Riku Mizuta, Gopolang Mohlabeng, David E. Morrissey, Douglas Tuckler
arxiv-2509-19428.description: Abstract We study inelastic dark matter produced via freeze-in through a light mediator with a mass splitting below the electron-positron threshold. In this regime, the heavier dark matter state is naturally long-lived compared to the age of the Universe and decays to the lighter state in association with photons.

arxiv-2601-13209.title: AI for Mathematics: Progress, Challenges, and Prospects
arxiv-2601-13209.creator: Haocheng Ju, Bin Dong
arxiv-2601-13209.description: Abstract AI for Mathematics (AI4Math) has emerged as a distinct field that leverages machine learning to navigate mathematical landscapes historically intractable for early symbolic systems. While mid-20th-century symbolic approaches successfully automated formal logic, they faced severe scalability limitations due to the combinatorial explosion of the search space. The recent integration of data-driven approaches has revitalized this pursuit.

arxiv-2602-13628.title: Compact LLM Deployment and World Model Assisted Offloading in Mobile Edge Computing Thanks: R. Zhang and D. Niyato are with the College of Computing and Data Science, Nanyang Technological University, Singapore (e-mail: ruichen.zhang@ntu.edu.sg, dniyato@ntu.edu.sg). Thanks: X. Luo, J. He, and J. Kan
arxiv-2602-13628.creator: Ruichen Zhang, Xiaofeng Luo, Jiayi He, Dusit Niyato, Jiawen Kang
arxiv-2602-13628.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Ruichen Zhang, Xiaofeng Luo, Jiayi He, Dusit Niyato, Jiawen Kang. This paper investigates compact large language model (LLM) deployment and world-model-assisted inference offloading in mobile edge computing (MEC) networks. We first propose an edge compact LLM deployment (ECLD) framework that jointly applies structured pruning, low-bit quantization, and knowledge distillation to construct edge-deployable LLM variants, and we evaluate these models using four complementary metrics: accessibility, energy consumption, hallucination rate, and generalization accuracy.

pmc-10531397.creator: Jürgen Kreiter, Sanja Škulj, Zlatko Brkljača, Sarah Bardakji, Mario Vazdar, Elena E Pohl, Ferdinando Palmieri, Magnus Monné
pmc-10531397.description: Mitochondrial adenine nucleotide translocase (ANT) exchanges ADP for ATP to maintain energy production in the cell. Its protonophoric function in the presence of long-chain fatty acids (FA) is also recognized. Our previous results imply that proton/FA transport can be best described with the FA cycling model, in which protonated FA transports the proton to the mitochondrial matrix.

pmc-11494545.title: Preliminary exploration of poor prognostic factor IL-33 and its involvement in perioperative immunotherapy in stage II–III lung squamous cell carcinoma: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-11494545.creator: Yan Liu, Pengpeng Liu, Rui Zhang, Nobuhiko Seki, Fabien Forest, Wolfgang M Brueckl, Cuicui Zhao, Chuangui Zhang, Jinpu Yu
pmc-11494545.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundCurrent knowledge about the prognostic role of interleukin-33 (IL-33) in lung squamous cell carcinoma (LUSC) remains limited, particularly in stage II–III patients. This study aimed to verify the correlation between IL-33 expression and poor prognosis in stage II–III LUSC patients at both gene and protein levels and to investigate the potential role of IL-33 blockade in combination with immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) in perioperative immunotherapy.MethodsA retrospective analysis was conducted of 103 patients with stage II–III LUSC who underwent surgical resection at Tianjin

pmc-11533369.title: Addiction consult service involvement in PrEP and PEP delivery for patients who inject drugs admitted to an urban essential hospital
pmc-11533369.creator: Hallie Rozansky, Paul J. Christine, Morgan Younkin, Jason M. Fox, Zoe M. Weinstein, Sebastian Suarez, Jessica Stewart, Natalija Farrell, Jessica L. Taylor
pmc-11533369.description: BackgroundAddiction medicine providers have a key role in HIV prevention amidst rising HIV incidence in persons who inject drugs (PWID). Pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) and post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) are vastly underutilized in this population. Inpatient hospitalization represents a potential touchpoint for initiation of HIV prophylaxis, though little research explores the role of addiction providers.

pmc-11639911.title: The Influence of Vowels on the Identification of Spoken Disyllabic Words in the Malayalam Language for Individuals with Hearing Loss
pmc-11639911.creator: Vijaya Kumar Narne, Dhanya Mohan, M Badariya, Sruthi Das Avileri, Saransh Jain, Sunil Kumar Ravi, Yerraguntla Krishna, Reesha Oovattil Hussain, Abdulaziz Almudhi, Peter J Kullar, Jameel Muzaffar
pmc-11639911.description: Background/Objectives: The present study investigates the reasons for better recognition of disyllabic words in Malayalam among individuals with hearing loss. This research was conducted in three experiments. Experiment 1 measured the psychometric properties (slope, intercept, and maximum scores) of disyllabic wordlists.

pmc-12644189.title: miR-7213-5p-mediated suppression of CCL19 in fibroblast cells may attenuate lupus nephritis
pmc-12644189.creator: Zhiying Gao, Jiahui Wang, Laizhi Luo, Likun Zhou, Yan Qin, Ke Zheng, Xuemei Li
pmc-12644189.description: Lupus nephritis (LN) is an immune-complex nephritis and one of the most severe organ manifestations of systemic lupus erythematosus. To elucidate the mechanisms underlying LN, we firstly performed comprehensive RNA sequencing and microRNA (miRNA) sequencing analyses on the kidneys of female lupus-prone MRL/lpr mice and female C57BL/6 mice.

pmc-12730691.title: Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy Phenocopies: Classification, Key Features, and Differential Diagnosis
pmc-12730691.creator: Lucio Teresi, Giancarlo Trimarchi, Roberto Licordari, Davide Restelli, Giovanni Taverna, Paolo Liotta, Antonino Micari, Ignazio Smecca, Gregory Dendramis, Dario Turturiello, Alessia Chiara Latini, Giulio Falasconi, Cesare de Gregorio, Pasquale Crea, Giuseppe Dattilo, Antonio Berruezo, Antonio Micari
pmc-12730691.description: Among cardiomyopathies, the hypertrophic phenotype is the most common, and hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) phenocopies represent a heterogeneous group of conditions. They are defined by a left ventricular wall thickness ≥15 mm in the absence of other causes such as loading conditions, ischemia, or valvular disease.
